edition: Written 1996; three-year fetal-measurement study, 2,436 does across 16 study areas
metric: Peak breeding/conception date reported for each study area
quality: Historical study. Source reports little annual variation in most areas; young or poorly conditioned does may breed later. Ecoregions are broad and study areas are samples rather than prediction polygons. Never infer north/south or east/west dividers from latitude/longitude.
automaticLookup: Official Gould ecoregion polygons identify ecological regions. HNTED displays a broad envelope of available study-area peaks within a region, labeled as an interpretation. No source-defined subdivision polygons were located; explicit user choice is required for a specific study-area peak. High Plains and Blackland Prairie have no standalone study choices.
ownership: Study agency-authored and publicly available; no open license located for study. Official Gould layer owner TPWD_Wildlife1 within TPWD organization1mtXwieMId59thmg; credits Gould1975 and TPWD GIS. Layer license is informational-use/no-warranty disclaimer, not an explicit redistribution license. Retain attribution before later publishing.
